Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Geometric Aqua and Black Angled Canvas Print in Silver Frame, 31.75" x 31.75"
Colors: Silver
Materials: canvas
This striking series of geometric shapes gives a contemporary flair to your room. Aqua and black forms, mixed with a few accent colors, create an eclectic, modern piece that is housed in a silver floater frame for a sophisticated look. Contemporary geometric shapes Hand-stretched canvas around engineered wood stretcher bar with floater frame in a silver finish; arrives ready to hang 31.75" x 31.75" Made to order
